subject.title: [Bug]: Mac app floods unbounded stacked device pairing approval alerts for one retrying device; approving stale alerts is a no-op

question: Should maintainers proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100976 as the canonical fix path for this protected device-pairing bug, or request a replacement repair?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label and the candidate fix spans gateway auth/pairing state plus native macOS alert behavior, so cleanup automation should not close or independently replace it without human review.

options.title: Review and land linked fix
options.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical fix if its gateway and macOS behavior proof/checks are acceptable.

options.title: Request a replacement repair
options.body: Ask for a narrower or corrected replacement if the PR's implementation or failing macOS checks are not acceptable.

options.title: Hold for live Mac proof
options.body: Keep both items open until a maintainer has real macOS proof that the alert pile collapses and a current request remains approvable.

recommendation.title: Review and land linked fix
recommendation.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical fix if its gateway and macOS behavior proof/checks are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current gateway/device-pairing routing candidate from recent source history, while the fix also needs Mac pairing review from steipete.
